Stalker's diary: June 28, 2017. Semyon and Ilyukha left me wounded in the school basement, said that they would soon come with help, left me a couple of first aid kits and bandages, I think it will do to patch up the wound, it was necessary to run into a pack of wild boars and in the city 
June 30, 2017. Two days have passed, the guys still haven't returned, I tried to contact them, it didn't work, there is no connection in the basement, and I can't crawl outside, the wound has stopped bleeding, there is very little food left, I hope they will return soon 
July 4, 2017. The wound has started to fester, I am hot, I am already imagining all sorts of nonsense, I can't sleep it is very painful, there are no more first aid kits and antibiotics, it seems no one will come for me 
July 10, 2017. Voice recording: *indistinct muttering noise*
